# offering provider

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:offeringProvider`](gmeow-offeringProvider.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/offeringProvider>

The agent that provides an offering or service. Projects to [schema:provider.](https://schema.org/provider.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent that provides a [`gmeow:Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md) — the provider behind the offered item.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at the offered item (that is [`gmeow:itemOffered`](gmeow-itemOffered.md)) and avoid duplicating [`gmeow:makesOffer`](gmeow-makesOffer.md)'s bearer — provider rides the [`Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md), [`makesOffer`](gmeow-makesOffer.md) rides the agent.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:offeringProvider`](gmeow-offeringProvider.md) on the [`gmeow:Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md) to the providing agent; it usually equals the agent that [`gmeow:makesOffer`](gmeow-makesOffer.md) it, projecting to [schema:provider.](https://schema.org/provider.)

### Examples

- ex:hostingOffer [`gmeow:offeringProvider`](gmeow-offeringProvider.md) ex:acme.
